author: E3D
limitations: Released drawing dimensions; thread helix, fillets and mark holes are simplified in generated CAD.

author: E3D
limitations: Nozzle dimensions do not establish availability of a particular stainless SKU.

author: Carpenter Technology
limitations: Room-temperature typical value; hot nozzle conductivity is bracketed, not automatically temperature dependent.

author: Kaban, Mhiaoui, Hoyer, Gasser (2005), reprinted in author thesis
location: PDF pp139-145, Table1 p145; absolute-temperature definition p144
limitations: Clean/reducing controlled-atmosphere measurements; oxide-covered jetting surface can differ. Cu3 is not Cu0.7.

author: Zhang et al. (2010)
limitations: Approximate graph reading near250-300C. Curves carry vertical offsets (+8,+3,-5,-10 micro-ohm cm), which must be removed.

author: H.A.Wheeler (1928)
limitations: 1% claim is shape restricted, not universal. Study uses as an estimate pending independent check/measurement.

author: US Bureau of Standards, Copper Wire Tables
limitations: Hot-wire correction and packing are estimates; AC/proximity, bus, switch and cooling details need checks.

author: JLCPCB
limitations: Stencil manufacturing capability is not nozzle service qualification; sealing, edge finish, wetting and thermal cycling require trials.

author: Sukhotskiy et al./Vader (2018)
limitations: Refractory nozzle and water-cooled coil; does not validate metal wall or our voltage/current budgets.

author: Polzin and Markusic, NASA technical report
limitations: Gallium pressure characterization and hot bismuth compatibility are separate tests. Macor/AlN insulating pump body, not evidence of solder drop-on-demand jetting or long-term solder/electrode compatibility.

author: Ensinger
limitations: Manufacturer explicitly requires application-specific checking of service-temperature figures. Not qualification as a molten-solder pressure seal or load-bearing pump body.

author: Zhang, Zhou, Liu (2020)
limitations: Liquid-metal circulation pump; geometry/fluid differ from solder DOD. Paper highlights current leakage into surrounding fluid and conductive walls; simple I B / depth is an upper screening estimate, not a qualified head.

author: Arnold Magnetic Technologies
limitations: A material-grade reference, not confirmation of stock 10 mm cubes. Study effective Br 0.95 T is an assumed hot-field value requiring supplier/temperature qualification; unit recoil permeability and ideal magnetization are approximations.

author: Souad Mhiaoui, 2007

facts.Sn60Pb40_resistivity: PDF page 107, printed page 102, Table 5.1; fit 250–1000 C; resistivity in microohm cm
facts.viscosity: PDF page 169, printed page 164, Table 7.1; eta0 in mPa s, Ea in kJ/mol; absolute temperature
facts.Sn60Pb40_surface_density: PDF page 145, reprinted Kaban et al. paper Table 1; absolute temperature

limitations: See solder-properties.json for units, temperature domains and uncertainty; Sn99Cu1 resistivity table is not substituted for Sn99.3Cu0.7.

Catalogue geometry confirms a purchasable size, not actual hot remanence or in-stock delivery. The study assumes Br=0.95 T and adjacent 5 mm discs with matched magnetization and no axial gap; actual grade, load line and temperature must be qualified.

facts: Stainless oxide inhibits soldering; appropriate flux or a nickel-plated solderable surface are preparation routes.
limitations: This establishes preparation options, not a calibrated molten-solder electrical contact resistivity or long-term nozzle compatibility.
